thm-hyp(list-partial(
  LA.VectorSpace(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace),
  Type.annotation(@n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, Nat),
  Type.annotation(@$\alpha$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, Type.to(LA.Fin(n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace))
), Logic.iff(LA.LinearlyDependent($\alpha$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Logic.exists-typed(@k, Type.to(LA.Fin(n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), $\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), Logic.and(LA.LinearRelation(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, $\alpha$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily, n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily), LA.Nontrivial($\mathbb{K}$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, n@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.finiteFamily)))))

values.zh-CN: $\alpha$ 线性相关当且仅当存在不全为零的系数，使线性组合为零。
values.en: $\alpha$ is dependent iff a nonzero coefficient family gives the zero linear combination.
